title: 4-Octyl itaconate attenuates LPS-induced acute kidney injury by activating Nrf2 and inhibiting STAT3 signaling.
authors: Xu, Lujun; Cai, Juan; Li, Chenrui; Yang, Ming; Duan, Tongyue; Zhao, Qing; Xi, Yiyun; Sun, Liya; He, Liyu; Tang, Chengyuan; Sun, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究4-OI通过Nrf2/STAT3信号减轻脓毒症急性肾损伤，仅含分子对接验证小分子-STAT3结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Septic acute kidney injury (S-AKI) is the leading form of acute kidney failure among hospitalized patients, and the inflammatory response is involved in this process. 4-octyl itaconate (4-OI) is a multi-target itaconate derivative with potent anti-inflammatory action. However, it remains elusive whether and how 4-OI contributes to the regulation of S-AKI. METHODS: We employed a lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced AKI murine model and explored the potential renoprotective effect of 4-OI in vivo. In vitro experiments, BUMPT cells, a murine renal tubular cell line, were conducted to examine the effects of 4-OI on inflammation, oxidative stress, and mitophagy. Moreover, STAT3 plasmid was transfected in BUMPT cells to investigate the role of STAT3 signaling in the 4-OI-administrated state. RESULTS: We demonstrate that 4-OI protects against S-AKI through suppressing inflammation and oxidative stress and enhancing mitophagy. 4-OI significantly reduced the levels of Scr, BUN, Ngal as well as the tubular injury in LPS-induced AKI mice. 4-OI restrained inflammation by reducing macrophage infiltration and suppressing the expression of IL-1beta and NLRP3 in the septic kidney. 4-OI also reduced ROS levels, as well as cleaved caspase-3 and boosted antioxidants such as HO-1, and NQO1 in mice. In addition, the 4-OI treatment significantly promoted mitophagy. Mechanistically, 4-OI activated Nrf2 signaling and suppressed phosphorylated STAT3 in vivo and vitro. Molecular docking revealed the binding affinity of 4-OI towards STAT3. ML385, a specific Nrf2 inhibitor, partially repressed the anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative effects of 4-OI and partially restricted the mitophagy induced by 4-OI in vivo and in vitro. Transfected with STAT3 plasmid partially suppressed mitophagy and the anti-inflammatory effect provoked by 4-OI in vitro. CONCLUSION: These data suggest that 4-OI ameliorates LPS-induced AKI by suppressing inflammation and oxidative stress and enhancing mitophagy through the overactivation of the Nrf2 signaling pathway, and inactivation of STAT3. Our study identifies 4-OI as a promising pharmacologic for S-AKI.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症急性肾损伤（S-AKI）是住院患者中急性肾衰竭的主要形式，炎症反应参与该过程。4-辛基衣康酸（4-OI）是一种多靶点衣康酸衍生物，具有强效抗炎作用。然而，4-OI是否以及如何调控S-AKI仍不清楚。方法：我们采用脂多糖（LPS）诱导的AKI小鼠模型，并探讨4-OI在体内的潜在肾脏保护作用。在体外实验中，使用小鼠肾小管细胞系BUMPT细胞，检测4-OI对炎症、氧化应激和线粒体自噬的影响。此外，在BUMPT细胞中转染STAT3质粒，以研究STAT3信号在4-OI处理状态下的作用。结果：我们证明4-OI通过抑制炎症和氧化应激以及增强线粒体自噬来保护S-AKI。4-OI显著降低了LPS诱导的AKI小鼠中Scr、BUN、Ngal水平以及肾小管损伤。4-OI通过减少巨噬细胞浸润和抑制脓毒症肾脏中IL-1β和NLRP3的表达来抑制炎症。4-OI还降低了ROS水平以及cleaved caspase-3，并增强了抗氧化剂如HO-1和NQO1在小鼠中的表达。此外，4-OI处理显著促进了线粒体自噬。机制上，4-OI在体内和体外激活了Nrf2信号并抑制了磷酸化STAT3。分子对接揭示了4-OI与STAT3的结合亲和力。ML385（一种特异性Nrf2抑制剂）部分抑制了4-OI的抗炎和抗氧化作用，并在体内和体外部分限制了4-OI诱导的线粒体自噬。在体外转染STAT3质粒部分抑制了4-OI引发的线粒体自噬和抗炎效应。结论：这些数据表明，4-OI通过过度激活Nrf2信号通路和失活STAT3，抑制炎症和氧化应激并增强线粒体自噬，从而改善LPS诱导的AKI。我们的研究将4-OI确定为S-AKI的一种有前景的药物。
